maddeler.e:
تنتشلون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَشِلُونَ (tantašilūna) /tan.ta.ʃi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# تُنْتَشَلُونَ (tuntašalūna) /tun.ta.ʃa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
